proposed_widenings.name: grant_traversal_mode
proposed_widenings.justification: Water Walk grants creatures the ability to treat liquid surfaces as harmless solid ground for movement. No existing OngoingOperation variant covers traversal capability grants. The v4 atom inventory has grant_hover (flight mode) but no equivalent for surface-walk-over-liquid. A new atom is needed that encodes 'treat surface type X as passable/harmless solid ground.'
proposed_widenings.evidence: Up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range gain this ability for the duration. [The ability is:] move across any liquid surface—such as water, acid, mud, snow, quicksand, or lava—as if it were harmless solid ground

proposed_widenings.name: OngoingOperation.grant_traversal_mode
proposed_widenings.justification: OngoingOperation is currently RollModifierOperation | DamageOnHitOperation. Water Walk's operation is neither. The surface type needs a new variant (e.g., { kind: 'grant_traversal_mode'; surfaceKind: 'liquid'; harmless: true }) to encode passive traversal capability grants.
proposed_widenings.evidence: move across any liquid surface … as if it were harmless solid ground

proposed_widenings.name: CastingTime.action with ritual flag
proposed_widenings.justification: Water Walk has a 1-Action primary casting time but carries the Ritual tag (can be cast as a ritual by adding 10 minutes). Current CastingTime.action has no ritual field. Only CastingTime.minutes has a ritual boolean. Alarm's 1-minute cast was encoded as minutes+ritual, but that does not apply here — Water Walk's base cast time is genuinely an action.

proposed_widenings.name: TargetSelection fixed-count mode
proposed_widenings.justification: Water Walk targets 'up to ten' creatures with no slot-scaling. The only choose_up_to count type is SlotScaling<number> which implies slot-level progression. A fixed choose_up_to count (not slot-driven) has no clean representation; SlotScaling with perSlotAboveBase=0 technically typechecks but is semantically dishonest.
proposed_widenings.evidence: Up to ten willing creatures of your choice within range

proposed_widenings.name: bonus_action_gate on traversal transition
proposed_widenings.justification: Water Walk has a secondary mechanic: an affected target must spend a Bonus Action to deliberately pass from the liquid surface into the liquid below (and vice versa). This is a bonus-action-gated mode transition with no existing subgraph representation. It differs from activation costs on spells — it is a per-target ongoing mode-switch cost.
proposed_widenings.evidence: An affected target must take a Bonus Action to pass from the liquid's surface into the liquid itself and vice versa, but if the target falls into the liquid, the target passes through the surface into the liquid below.

notes: Water Walk's family is ongoing_effect (timed 1-hour non-concentration, multi-target). The spell fits the header shape cleanly (level 3, transmutation, action, point 30 ft, VSM, timed 1h). The blocking gap is OngoingOperation: neither roll_modifier nor damage_on_hit can express 'grant ability to walk on liquid surfaces.' The secondary mechanic (bonus-action gate to enter liquid) also has no representation. Ritual-on-action-cast is a secondary surface_widening. Dominant classification: atom_widening.
